label: Reports
description: Choose which reports are emailed, how often each one runs, and who receives them.

actions.label: Send a report now
actions.hint: Generate a report and email it right away, without waiting for its schedule.

modal.title: Send a report now
modal.description: The report covers the period it would on its next scheduled run, and goes to the recipients below.

fields.label: Send scheduled reports
fields.description: Master switch. Turn off to stop every scheduled report without uninstalling the app.

fields.label: Send even when there is nothing to report
fields.description: When off, a report is skipped if its period had nothing in it — no paid orders, no discounted orders, no customers, no stock running low, no abandoned carts, or no subscription activity.

fields.label: Recipients
fields.description: Email addresses that receive every report that is switched on. To send a report to someone else as well, add them under that report's tab. Leave both empty to keep reports in the dashboard without emailing anyone.

params.title: Each report
params.description: Switch each report on, choose how often it runs, and add anyone who should get only that report.

fields.label: Sales
fields.description: Revenue, orders, top products and the day-by-day picture.

fields.label: Reporting period
fields.description: Daily arrives every morning, weekly every Monday, every 2 weeks on alternate Mondays, monthly on the 1st — always at 08:00 UTC.

fields.label: Also send this report to
fields.description: These addresses get only the sales report, in addition to the main recipients list.

fields.label: Include top products
fields.description: Lists the 10 products that earned the most. The report shows 5, with Show more for the rest; the email lists 5. Turn off to leave the list out of the report and email.

fields.label: Include daily breakdown
fields.description: Adds a day-by-day table of orders and revenue.

fields.label: Customers
fields.description: Customers who bought, new versus returning, repeat buyers, and your top customers by spend.

fields.label: Also send this report to
fields.description: These addresses get only the customer report, in addition to the main recipients list.

fields.label: Include top customers
fields.description: Lists the 10 customers who spent the most. The report shows 5, with Show more for the rest; the email lists 5. Turn off to leave customer names and emails out of the report and email.

fields.label: Inventory
fields.description: What is out of stock or running low, and how many days the remaining stock will last at the last 30 days' rate of sale.

fields.label: Also send this report to
fields.description: These addresses get only the inventory report, in addition to the main recipients list.

fields.label: Low stock threshold
fields.description: Stock-tracked products and variants at or below this level are listed as low. Each report lists up to 50 out-of-stock and low items.

fields.label: Products
fields.description: Best and slowest sellers, the biggest movers against the previous period, and products that did not sell.

fields.label: Also send this report to
fields.description: These addresses get only the product report, in addition to the main recipients list.

fields.label: List products with no sales
fields.description: Active products, older than the period, that sold nothing in it.

fields.label: Discounts
fields.description: How much was discounted, through which coupons and promotions, and the revenue those orders brought in.

fields.label: Also send this report to
fields.description: These addresses get only the discount report, in addition to the main recipients list.

fields.label: Abandoned carts
fields.description: Carts customers left without checking out, how many came back as orders, and the products most often left behind.

fields.label: Also send this report to
fields.description: These addresses get only the abandoned cart report, in addition to the main recipients list.

fields.label: Subscriptions
fields.description: Active subscriptions and monthly recurring revenue, what started, was canceled or paused, failed renewals, and what renews in the next 7 days.

fields.label: Also send this report to
fields.description: These addresses get only the subscription report, in addition to the main recipients list.
